approaches_tried.description: Assumed the lean extension was already loaded/deployed, per the plan's own framing ('the round closes with a .claude/ redeploy')
approaches_tried.reason: discovered .claude-extensions.json's active extensions list (core, literature, email, nix, nvim, memory) did not include lean at all -- no lean file had ever been deployed to .claude/** on this host. Loaded it via a headless nvim manager.load('lean', {confirm=false, project_dir=...}) call, additive only, before proceeding with the normal deploy-headless.sh resync.

deviations.description: Run the repo's shell-test runner if it covers them
deviations.reason: the repo-wide shell-test runner (tests/run-all.sh) is deferred by deploy-headless.sh's own verify-deploy.sh call via --skip-slow by default; this task follows that same established convention rather than paying its full multi-minute cost. Every lean-specific test file was run individually instead: test-lean-comparator-run.sh (28/0/1), test-lean-challenge-snapshot.sh (14/0/0), test-lean-mcp-preflight-check.sh (17/0), test-lean-mcp-registration.sh (7/0), test-lean-src-roots.sh (10/0), test-lean-sorry-census.sh (via the sibling-regression check inside test-lean-comparator-run.sh).
